en: Illustrated postcard-like trade card showing an old-time Chinese postal courier in orange robes and conical hat running through a palace courtyard, holding a mail bag and a vessel. Behind him are figures in traditional dress and a pavilion with East Asian architectural style, surrounded by blossom trees and a balustrade. The lower margin contains French text and a blue facsimile signature, suggesting a collectible advertising card.
